sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Secret to Productivity is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello. Before everything happened in the city, there was this software company. I can't remember its name anymore, only that they made the best software in their niche. I still use some of their work to this day. It wasn't a large company, and I still can't figure out how they managed to produce such high-quality software in so little time. They had to be hiding something, and I'd like to know what it was. See if you can uncover their secret. Maybe you'll notice something that wouldn't stand out to someone who grew up here."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Unravel the secret of the IT firm's employees' high morale on Streets of Tarkov
- Survive and extract from the location

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"So, a hookah lounge... Not a bad carrot. Around here, we're much more familiar with the stick, so I never would've made that connection."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in Raid | Notes |
| Relaxation room key | 1 | Required | N/A | Unlocks the door to the "Hive" hookah lounge in the Malevicha street no. 5 building on Streets of Tarkov. |
In this quest you have to find and enter the "Hive" hookah lounge in the Malevicha street no. 5 building on Streets of Tarkov. A Relaxation room key is required to access it.

Dying before extracting will reset the first part of this quest.
